```{=html}
<style>
.w066-dd { max-width: 620px; margin: 0 auto; font-size: 0.9rem; }
.w066-dd .w066-pool {
  display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; min-height: 44px;
  padding: 8px; border-radius: 6px;
  border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #ccc); margin-bottom: 0.75rem;
}
.w066-dd .w066-buckets { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; }
.w066-dd .w066-bucket {
  flex: 1 1 250px; min-width: 250px; padding: 8px;
  border: 2px dashed var(--bs-border-color, #999); border-radius: 6px;
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); cursor: pointer;
}
.w066-dd .w066-bucket.w066-armed { border-color: #d81e2e; }
.w066-dd .w066-btitle { text-align: center; font-weight: 700; margin-bottom: 6px; }
.w066-dd .w066-slot { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; min-height: 40px; }
.w066-dd .w066-chip {
  padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 6px; cursor: grab; user-select: none;
  border: 1.5px solid #d81e2e; color: var(--bs-body-color, #222);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); font-weight: 600; text-align: center;
  font-size: 0.85rem;
}
.w066-dd .w066-chip.w066-picked { outline: 3px solid #d81e2e; outline-offset: 2px; }
.w066-dd .w066-chip.w066-right { border: 2px solid #2e7d32; }
.w066-dd .w066-chip.w066-wrong { border: 2px solid #d81e2e; }
.w066-dd .w066-controls { display: flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
.w066-dd button {
  padding: 5px 14px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--bs-border-color, #999);
  background: var(--bs-body-bg, #fff); color: var(--bs-body-color, #222); cursor: pointer;
}
.w066-dd .w066-note { font-size: 0.78rem; opacity: 0.7; font-style: italic; }
.w066-dd .w066-msg { font-weight: 700; min-height: 1.4em; text-align: center; margin-top: 0.5rem; }
.w066-dd .w066-msg.ok { color: #2e7d32; }
.w066-dd .w066-msg.bad { color: #d81e2e; }
</style>
<div class="w066-dd iw" id="w066-dd">
  <div class="w066-pool" aria-label="scenarios to sort"></div>
  <div class="w066-buckets">
    <div class="w066-bucket" data-bucket="yes"><div class="w066-btitle">Encryption answers this threat</div><div class="w066-slot"></div></div>
    <div class="w066-bucket" data-bucket="no"><div class="w066-btitle">Encryption achieves nothing here</div><div class="w066-slot"></div></div>
  </div>
  <div class="w066-controls">
    <button type="button" class="w066-check iw-check">Check</button>
    <button type="button" class="w066-reset iw-reset">Reset</button>
    <button type="button" class="w066-solution iw-solution">Show solution</button>
    <span class="w066-note">(no fun if you click it right away)</span>
  </div>
  <div class="w066-msg iw-msg" role="status"></div>
</div>
<script>
(function () {
  const root = document.getElementById('w066-dd');
  const pool = root.querySelector('.w066-pool');
  const buckets = [...root.querySelectorAll('.w066-bucket')];
  const msg = root.querySelector('.w066-msg');
  const ITEMS = [
    {"t": "An attacker on shared Wi-Fi captures packets between browser and server", "a": "yes"},
    {"t": "Customer records are stolen through an SQL-injection flaw in the application", "a": "no"},
    {"t": "A disk drive is stolen from the data centre", "a": "yes"},
    {"t": "A weak administrator password is guessed", "a": "no"},
    {"t": "The key is stored next to the data it protects, with the same access to both", "a": "no"},
    {"t": "An outsider reads an exposed object-storage bucket (keys held elsewhere)", "a": "yes"}
  ];
  let picked = null;

  function chips() { return [...root.querySelectorAll('.w066-chip')]; }
  function unpick() {
    if (picked) picked.classList.remove('w066-picked');
    picked = null;
    buckets.forEach(b => b.classList.remove('w066-armed'));
  }
  function clearMarks() {
    chips().forEach(c => c.classList.remove('w066-right', 'w066-wrong'));
    msg.textContent = ''; msg.className = 'w066-msg iw-msg';
  }
  function place(bucket, chip) {
    bucket.querySelector('.w066-slot').appendChild(chip);
    clearMarks();
  }
  function makeChip(item, i) {
    const c = document.createElement('div');
    c.className = 'w066-chip';
    c.textContent = item.t;
    c.dataset.key = String(i);
    c.dataset.answer = item.a;
    c.draggable = true;
    c.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
      e.stopPropagation();
      if (c.parentElement === pool) {
        if (picked === c) { unpick(); return; }
        unpick(); picked = c; c.classList.add('w066-picked');
        buckets.forEach(b => b.classList.add('w066-armed'));
      } else { pool.appendChild(c); unpick(); clearMarks(); }
    });
    c.addEventListener('dragstart', e => e.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain', c.dataset.key));
    return c;
  }
  buckets.forEach(bucket => {
    bucket.addEventListener('click', () => { if (picked) { place(bucket, picked); unpick(); } });
    bucket.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
    bucket.addEventListener('drop', e => {
      e.preventDefault(); e.stopPropagation();
      const key = e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
      const chip = root.querySelector('.w066-chip[data-key="' + key + '"]');
      if (chip) { place(bucket, chip); unpick(); }
    });
  });
  pool.addEventListener('dragover', e => e.preventDefault());
  pool.addEventListener('drop', e => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const key = e.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain');
    const chip = root.querySelector('.w066-chip[data-key="' + key + '"]');
    if (chip) { pool.appendChild(chip); unpick(); clearMarks(); }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w066-check').addEventListener('click', () => {
    let right = 0, wrong = 0;
    chips().forEach(c => {
      c.classList.remove('w066-right', 'w066-wrong');
      const b = c.closest('.w066-bucket');
      if (!b) return;
      if (b.dataset.bucket === c.dataset.answer) { c.classList.add('w066-right'); right++; }
      else { c.classList.add('w066-wrong'); wrong++; }
    });
    const unplaced = ITEMS.length - right - wrong;
    if (right === ITEMS.length) {
      msg.textContent = '✓ All correct — name the threat first, then choose the control that meets it.';
      msg.className = 'w066-msg iw-msg ok';
    } else if (wrong === 0) {
      msg.textContent = 'Keep going — ' + unplaced + ' card(s) still to place.';
      msg.className = 'w066-msg iw-msg';
    } else {
      msg.textContent = '✗ Not yet — the red cards are in the wrong box. Send them back and try again.';
      msg.className = 'w066-msg iw-msg bad';
    }
  });
  root.querySelector('.w066-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
    chips().sort((a, b) => Number(a.dataset.key) - Number(b.dataset.key))
           .forEach(c => pool.appendChild(c));
    unpick(); clearMarks();
  });
  root.querySelector('.w066-solution').addEventListener('click', () => {
    unpick();
    chips().sort((a, b) => Number(a.dataset.key) - Number(b.dataset.key)).forEach(c => {
      const bucket = buckets.find(b => b.dataset.bucket === c.dataset.answer);
      bucket.querySelector('.w066-slot').appendChild(c);
    });
    chips().forEach(c => { c.classList.remove('w066-wrong'); c.classList.add('w066-right'); });
    msg.textContent = 'Solution shown — reset to try it yourself.';
    msg.className = 'w066-msg iw-msg ok';
  });
  ITEMS.forEach((it, i) => pool.appendChild(makeChip(it, i)));
})();
</script>
```
